committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 12 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend fell from $131.95 to $95.03 over the last 7 days and clicks dropped from 22 to 16, yet conversions sit at zero either way, so the lower spend hasn't cost any performance that wasn't already missing.

Impression share is 10% with rank lost at 77.4% against budget lost at 16.1%, so ad rank is the binding constraint right now, not budget. Kontrol Search National stays ENABLED as intended post restart with postRestartClicksSince8Sept at 13.

Sessions dropped 49% week on week (32 vs 63) and Direct fell from 36 to 12, but Direct still mixes in Chris' own pre filter visits so it isn't a demand signal. Of the 32 sessions last7, /ai-automation-agency.html pulled 13, the second biggest landing page after the homepage's 15.

Organic Search ticked up slightly (7 vs 5) but Search Console (data through 9 Sept, two days behind yesterday) shows just 3 clicks from 262 impressions over 8 days, so unpaid visibility is still thin. LinkedIn sessions sit at zero despite Chris posting there, which points to untagged links rather than no interest.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword matched RSA headlines for the serving ad groups are still open, action these.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict rather than before it, the confirm then count change is still pending.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update it to match the current site stats.
